company.productNote: Model families named in the 2025–26 integrated annual report. This company (formerly Tata Motors Limited) holds the passenger-vehicle business, including Jaguar Land Rover; the trucks and buses business moved to a separate listed company, Tata Motors Limited, on 1 October 2025 and is not covered here. The report’s photographs are advertising images, so pictures are original illustrations.
